info.name: Verdant Dock - E2E happy path (signup to email-to-case) - testdata.help
info.description:
End-to-end happy path for the Verdant Dock demo store (https://shop.verdant-v1.testthis.now), driven through its JSON API with the Test Helper API v1 at https://api.testdata.help/v1 (guide: https://api.testdata.help/v1/llms.txt).

00 Staff login - Sally signs in (password + TOTP from totp/get?key=automation) so this run's source IP joins her IP history
0 Setup - run id (lists/codes), unique vd.<rand8>@testdata.help customer, AU name (names/get), random 4-digit gate code, random METRO Melbourne address
1 Sign up - signup, verification code caught with mail/pop?wait=20, verify, TOTP enrol, secret stored with totp/set, activate with totp/get
2 Sign in - password + TOTP (replay-safe code choice)
3 Order - address, cart (1 x {{sku}}), quote, first available delivery window, order with mock test card, invoice email
3b Chat - ask the assistant each of chatQuestions, end the chat, check the CLOSED CHAT case under Help and the transcript email
4 Email-to-case - mail/send from the customer's address to the support address with the gate code, wait for the [C-yymmdd-XXXXX] case email, confirm the case and code via /v1/cases
5 Staff view - Sally can see the new customer, order and case
6 Bank the account under VD_USERPOOL, register the order under VD_CLEANUP, logout

Run: newman run verdant-dock-e2e.testdata-help.postman_collection.json
PREREQUISITES for folder 4: (a) the testdata.help stack must allow the support address - deploy with -EmailSendAllowedDomains "testthis.now" (or -EmailSendAllowedTo "support-v1@testthis.now"), otherwise mail/send returns 403; (b) SES in us-west-1 must have production access, because the sandbox only delivers to verified identities.
The Verdant Dock app must also be able to send to @testdata.help addresses (folders 1, 3, 3b and 4 catch its emails there).
